name: cn_mof_bulletins_list
description: List China's Ministry of Finance (财政部) published oversight bulletins on accounting firms, audit firms and asset-appraisal firms: fiscal and accounting supervision inspection bulletins (财会监督检查公告) with typical cases of audit failure, administrative penalty decisions against named audit firms, annual lists of firms selected for practice-quality inspection, and serious-dishonesty (失信主体) and delivery notices. Answers which audit or appraisal firms the Ministry has penalised, inspected or named, and when, with the link to the official bulletin. FIRMS ONLY: rows about individuals are omitted and counted. About 10 rows per page, newest first; `query` (Chinese words) and `kind` match titles on the page read only. No match says which page was read. Example: kind=inspection_bulletin.

query.description: Chinese words matched in the titles of the page read (处罚, 检查名单, 失信). Optional.

kind.description: Filter rows on the page read by bulletin type. Optional.

page.description: Page number, 1 = newest (default 1). The response gives pages_total.

name: cn_mof_bulletin_get
description: Read one Ministry of Finance (财政部) oversight bulletin: the text of a fiscal and accounting supervision inspection bulletin (typical cases naming audit firms, fines and sanctions), a penalty decision summary against an audit firm, or a list of firms selected for practice-quality inspection, plus the firm names found in it, the date and the type. Takes the `bulletin_url` of a row from cn_mof_bulletins_list. Clauses naming accountants, appraisers and company officers are left out and counted.

bulletin_url.description: Bulletin link as returned by cn_mof_bulletins_list.
